description: This file declares functions and includes headers related to scheduling and performing device downloads in a TR-069 management context. It defines an interface for scheduling downloads, initialization, and cleanup.

methods.name: DM_ENG_Device_DoScheduleDownload
methods.description: Function to initiate a scheduled download on the device with parameters like command key, file type, URL, credentials, file size, target filename, and time window list.

methods.name: DM_AmxScheduleDownload_init
methods.description: Initializes the schedule download context or module using the provided bus context.

methods.name: DM_AmxScheduleDownload_clean
methods.description: Cleans up resources associated with scheduled downloads.
